claims: Rory McIlroy won his second consecutive green jacket at the 2026 Masters Tournament on Sunday, April 12.
Rory McIlroy finished the 2026 Masters Tournament at 13-under par.
The 2026 Masters win was Rory McIlroy's 30th PGA Tour victory.
The 2026 Masters win was Rory McIlroy's sixth major championship.
Rory McIlroy made a crucial birdie on the 12th hole at the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Rory McIlroy finished with a 2-under 70 on Sunday at the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Rory McIlroy became only the fourth player in history to win back-to-back Masters tournaments.
Sergio Garcia received a code-of-conduct warning after damaging a tee box and breaking his driver on the second hole at the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Rory McIlroy secured his lead with birdies at Nos. 12 and 13 at the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Scottie Scheffler finished in solo second at the 2026 Masters Tournament.
The final round coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament was broadcast on CBS and Paramount+.
